~ is our magic regression symbol. Basically, if you connect two lists of data with a ~, we adjust every
free parameter to make the lists as close to each other as possible.
Since table columns are each lists, the easiest way to make a regression is to create a new table of
data, and then write an equation like y ~mx +b. Here, we’ll adjust m & b to find the best linear model.
If you instead type y ~ax +bx +c, we’ll find the best quadratic fit.
You can click to plot residuals, or use residuals in other expressions. For example mean(e ) is
the mean of the squares of the residuals.
If x and y are table columns,
then y ~ mx + b is a regression
that finds the least squares values
of m and b and plots the best fit
line.
